name: Poliwrath

abilities.name: Counterattack
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon, do 20 damage to the Attacking Pokémon.

flavor:
Its body is solid muscle. When swimming through
cold seas, Poliwrath uses its impressive arms to
smash through drift ice and plow forward.

pokedex.text: NO. 0062 Tadpole Pokémon HT: 4'3" WT: 119 lbs.
